Vikas Singh

+91 8218636340 Noida, INDIA

vs185085@gmail.com LinkedIn

SUMMARY

Experienced software engineer with 7 years of expertise in event-driven, object-oriented, multi-threaded, real-time, cloud-based, SaaS, API architecture. Proﬁcient in scalable, high-performance, microservices-based distributed software design & development, and implementation.

SKILLS

Problem Solving: Data Structures, Algorithms, Microservices, Object Oriented Design. Language: Java, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, JQuery. Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot,Dropwizard, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Hibernate. Database: Oracle, MySql, Redis. (Basic Knowledge of MongoDB, ElasticSearch) Tools: Kafka, Spark, OCI, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Junit, Flyway, Git, BitBucket.

Professional Experience

Oracle - Senior Member Of Technical Staff (November 2022 - Present) Project: Access Governance Cloud



Implemented libraries to be used by many other services such as redis global cache, unique ID Generation, generic query pattern, ﬂyway schema migration and kafka event library.

Planned and developed generic webhook client to publish change events. ● Implemented redis caching layer for HTTP APIs resulting in 70% higher throughput. ● Planned and Implemented a data pipeline that ingests large volumes of data daily using kafka, spark and OCI services that provides the platform for the rest of the micro services.

Developed microservices for various reports, data plane API using openAPI speciﬁcation. ● Optimized database queries, resulting in a 50% reduction in data retrieval times.

Nagarro Software - Senior Engineer (May 2021 - November 2022) Project: Generic Federation platform

Planned and implemented Aerospike caching layer resulting in high availability, low latency,

and high performance of Flipkart’s core B2C service.

Planned and implemented Debug functionality and chrome extension, Reducing overall

debugging efforts by 80%.

Added signiﬁcant revenue impacting features, such as new widgets onboarding on Flipkart’s homepage, snippets, aerospike cache integration and on-call support for production issues. Integrated NewRelic for observability and real time visibility of service level performance metrics.



Algoworks Technologies - Software Engineer - (April 2019 - May 2021) Projects: Demica | SymTrain | Mecan

Developed and maintained systems for transaction processing such as handling debits,

credits, transfers, payments etc.

Worked on ingesting, storing, and transforming ﬁnancial data for analysis.

● ● Planned and Implemented Spring batch job to periodically publish training data to AWS S3. ● Automated schema migration using Liquibase integration in CI/CD pipeline.

Integrated Stripe payment gateway for payment processing.

Infogain India pvt. ltd. - Software Engineer (October 2017 - April 2019) Projects: DataBloks | FedEx

Led a team of 5 developers on a startup Inventory Management Product from scratch,

collaborating directly with clients for planning, design and development.

Participated in Agile development sprints, consistently delivering features on time and

within budget.

Optimization of billing and discount features of FedEx enterprise products.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, Ghaziabad (2014 - 2017)

Percentage: 72.5%

Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering

Govt. Polytechnic College, Mahoba (2011 - 2014)

Percentage: 78%

High School : Science

Aadarsh Vidya Mandir, Nagar Bazar, Basti (2010 - 2011)

Percentage: 76%
